items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: well I played with the Tulane band. Who was the band director at that time? Dr. Martin Tenhor.

ctx.x: Did you study music at all at Tulane while you were there?

No, I was in architecture. Uh huh. I was in, in architecture. In fact, the, the timpanis that they got at Tulane were bought from me. Were bought from you? For me. For you. For me. I had a set of, first set of pedal timpanis in New Orleans. And, uh, and, uh, picked them out and they ordered them and bought them. And, uh, I was, uh, well I played with the Tulane band. Who was the band director at that time? Dr. Martin Tenhor. And then, uh, after that was, uh, Dr. When we went to California. I went to, I went to…
Um, you were, uh, you were active with the Sugar Bowl, too, for years, weren't you?
